overview:
This 8 day Moremi and Khwai camping safari is an 8-day, 7-night mobile camping trip that starts and ends in Maun, Botswana. You camp 3 nights at Xakanaxa in Moremi Game Reserve, 3 nights in the Khwai Concession and 1 night at Kaziikini in the Sankuyo community area. The dry months, roughly May to October, are best for wildlife. It is priced from USD 3,600 per adult and suits travellers who want real bush camping.

All meals and drinks, park fees, activities and laundry are included, and the crew sets up each camp so you can focus on the wildlife.

Why choose an 8 day Moremi and Khwai camping safari?

Moremi Game Reserve protects the eastern Okavango Delta, and the Xakanaxa area sits among lagoons, floodplains and woodland where predators and plains game meet. Staying 3 nights there gives time for slow, patient game drives and an optional boat trip on the Moanachira Channel.

The Khwai Concession borders Moremi and offers mokoro (dugout canoe) trips and excellent predator sightings. The last night at Kaziikini, a community-run area, adds a quieter stop with good birding and stargazing far from city lights.

  • Wildlife lovers: lions, leopards, wild dogs, cheetahs, elephants and buffalo.
  • Slow travellers: 3 nights in each main area, so there is no rushing between camps.
  • Water lovers: mokoro excursions in Khwai and an optional boat trip in Moremi.

What to expect on the 8 day Moremi and Khwai camping safari

Day 1 starts with a welcome and briefing at Maun Airport, then a drive to the Xakanaxa area of Moremi Game Reserve. After lunch at camp you head out on an afternoon game drive and stop for sundowners. Days 2 and 3 follow the same rhythm, with early morning and late afternoon drives and an optional boat trip on the Moanachira Channel.

On day 4 you drive to the Khwai Concession, game viewing on the way. Days 4 to 6 are spent in Khwai, with long morning game drives and afternoon mokoro excursions through papyrus-lined channels, guided by local polers.

On day 7 you drive south to Kaziikini for an afternoon game drive and, on clear nights, stargazing. On day 8 you take a final morning game drive, then return to Maun for your hotel or flight.

Is 8 days too long for Moremi and Khwai?

Eight days is not too long for Moremi and Khwai, because 3 nights in each area give you around a dozen game drives plus mokoro time, which greatly improves your chances of seeing leopards and wild dogs. If you have less time, our 5-day Okavango trip covers the same two areas. Our best time to visit Botswana guide helps you pick your month.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 8 day Moremi and Khwai camping safari?
faq.a: The 8 day Moremi and Khwai camping safari runs all year, but the dry season from about May to October usually gives the best game viewing, as wildlife gathers near the lagoons and channels of Moremi and Khwai. The green season from November to April brings lush scenery, newborn animals and excellent birding.
